failure_modes.mode: JobSpy distribution installed but transitive import missing
failure_modes.cause: --no-deps provisioning omits a newly required runtime package
failure_modes.detection: Actual jobspy import smoke in Docker build and preflight fixture
failure_modes.mitigation: Install declared runtime prerequisites and fail build before serving broken discovery

failure_modes.mode: Payment failures repeatedly request the same blocked provider
failure_modes.cause: Batch treats account-level failures as individual job errors
failure_modes.effect: Noise and unnecessary requests; failed work miscounted as successful
failure_modes.mitigation: Safe classified exception, per-batch circuit stop, retained retryable work and accurate attempted/succeeded/failed/deferred counts

failure_modes.mode: Raw provider error or key is exposed
failure_modes.cause: Copying HTTP response/error into logs or API diagnostics
failure_modes.mitigation: Safe error categories and configuration presence booleans only

failure_modes.cause: Automatic fallback from billing failure to another provider
failure_modes.mitigation: Present UI route instructions; do not change billing or provider preferences automatically
